verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents bulk-style capabilities like batch payments, bulk vendor/employee payments across 150+ countries, and inviting large numbers of team members, but these are platform/API features, not clearly exposed through the AI-native MCP interface. The MCP server docs list only single-item actions (pay a vendor, submit a reimbursement, query transactions with filters) with no explicit bulk/batch operation support for AI agents. Missing for 10: MCP/agent-level bulk operation tools, evidence of an AI agent invoking batch payments or bulk card issuance, and confirmation that 'batch payments' extends to the AI-native/MCP surface rather than just REST API/SDK.
